bullets: • Name the exact data source field and JSON structure to read from.
• Specify numeric display format, color values, and font sizes with precision.
• State fallback explicitly—e.g., display zero or em-dash, never conditional logic.
• Reference existing styled components instead of describing visual style from scratch.
• Avoid subjective descriptors like sexier, spicier, cooler without concrete visual examples.
• Separate conflicting style goals into separate stories, never bundle contradictory aesthetics.
• Include calculation formulas in plain text, not abstract descriptions of math.
• Describe user-facing text exactly as it should appear, including capitalization and punctuation.
